query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM privacy.contact c WHERE c.oldest_key_version < $1 OR (c.phone IS NOT NULL AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM privacy.contact_index i WHERE i.contact_id = c.id AND i.purpose = $4 AND i.key_version <> ALL($3::int4[])) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest($3::int4[]) AS k(v) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM privacy.contact_index i WHERE i.contact_id = c.id AND i.purpose = $4 AND i.key_version = k.v))))) AS "contacts!", (SELECT count(*) FROM privacy.stated_name WHERE key_version < $1 OR index_version < $2) AS "stated!", (SELECT count(*) FROM privacy.staff_phone WHERE key_version < $1) AS "staff!", (SELECT count(*) FROM privacy.business_mailbox WHERE key_version < $1 OR id IN (SELECT mailbox_id FROM privacy.business_mailbox_index WHERE key_version < $2)) AS "mailboxes!", (SELECT count(*) FROM privacy.photo WHERE key_version < $1) AS "photos!"
